title: did not work as well as expected
text:
did not work as well as expected. I placed the plate on the two burners and let it warm up for about 5-10min. I placed my items on the plate and realized it was not evenly heated. Some places were cold and other places were burning the food quickly. The food I was cooking was ultimately not worth keeping. I am not sure if just needed more warm up time or if that is just how the product is.

The plate is cast iron and very dense. I do like the two different surfaces.
